text_block_list.text: All right! That was pretty good!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And it was a G1, too. Surely people will
start
seeing me as—
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Cityyyyy!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Did you all see me run?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You're so pretty when you run!
City, you're
the best!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити, huh? I've never heard of her
before,
but she looks so gorgeous when
she runs.
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
She really was beautiful... Who knew
someone
could look that good so
sweaty?! Models are
amazing!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: "Pretty"? "Beautiful"? Give me a break...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
In the end, they're still just praising my
looks. Is
that all I'm good for?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Cityyy! Look at us!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Damn it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Huh... I like the look in her eyes.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Very interestin'. I gotta get on and make
my
debut soon!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... bzzzzt...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Uhh, hello?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
What do you want? I told you not to call
me on
race days, remember?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't be so cranky. I just wanted to
let you
know how I felt about the race.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
First of all, good job. It was a great race.
You met
your fans' expectations
perfectly. And your
running, it was just
so...
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text: So beautiful.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
Keep up the great work on the Tiara
tour and
show us more of your brilliance.
This will give a
boost to your modeling
career as well.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text: You are going for the Triple Tiara, right? I'm looking forward to it. Well then, good luck.
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text: ...Now I get it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Make yourself a doll and that's all they'll
see you
as.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Just a pretty doll with no will of its own.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I chose the Hanshin J.F. because it's
what my fans
wanted.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But that's just pandering to those who
want to see
me for my beauty.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's the same with my modeling. After all,
it wasn't
me who decided to take that
path.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
No wonder I can't change. All I do is
what others
tell me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: You just didn't want to let them down.

text_block_list.text: So, what? I can't do anything about it?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I won't settle for that. Sure, I do want to
please
my fans...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: But I want to choose how, even if it means betraying expectations. If I don't, I'll never get what I want.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'll make them accept me on my own
terms!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
So, I've decided. I won't run in the Tiara
tour.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I want to be the best. And that means
going for
the Classic Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown consists of the
Satsuki
Sho, Japanese Derby, and
Kikuka Sho, each of
which is held around
the same time as a
corresponding Tiara
tour race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's the most prestigious tour of all. In
particular,
those who win the Derby are
all but guaranteed
to go down in history.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You might have had plans in place for
me to win
the Tiara tour, but...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Do you mind if I turn that all upside
down?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I won't thank you yet. I already told you
how I'm
selfish.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Instead, I'll repay you by making you
famous as a
Derby trainer.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to finish first in the world's
most heated
race. Then...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
They'll have to recognize me for who I
am. For my
running!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to make preparations
for the
Classic Triple Crown's first
race—the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
